name: nve-auth
description: Sign in with Google, GitHub, GitLab, or continue as Guest. OAuth client IDs are read from env vars or product.overrides.json at runtime — nothing is hard-coded.

nvecode.auth.google.clientId.description: Google OAuth client ID. Falls back to env var NVE_GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, then product.overrides.json.

nvecode.auth.github.clientId.description: GitHub OAuth client ID. Falls back to env var NVE_GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

nvecode.auth.gitlab.clientId.description: GitLab OAuth client ID. Falls back to env var NVE_GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

nvecode.auth.gitlab.baseUrl.description: GitLab instance URL (use https://gitlab.example.com for self-managed).

nvecode.auth.guestProfileName.description: Display name used for the local Guest profile.
